author: Tunev
name: Creality Monitor
description: Live print status, temperatures and camera stream from a Creality K-series 3D printer (K1, K1C, K1 Max, K1 SE, K2 Plus) on a Corsair Xeneon Edge card. Should also work with other Creality printers that expose the same local network status API (port 9999) and WebRTC camera (port 8000); LAN Mode must be enabled on the printer.
